basic_profile.bio: Avid gamer and tech enthusiast based in Sydney, Australia. I started exploring the world of Tarkov about two years ago, drawn in by the challenge and complexity of the game. When I'm not gaming, I work as a software developer, which allows me to balance my love for technology and creativity. I'm generally online during the evenings and weekends, as my work hours are fairly flexible. I'm currently single, and I enjoy spending my free time hiking, experimenting with new tech, and of course, diving deep into intense gaming sessions.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: Having a background in computer science, I am well-versed in software development and have a keen interest in gaming systems. My expertise is largely self-taught through extensive personal projects and online courses, complemented by my professional experience in the tech industry.
